2609.13543.title: Asclepius: An Adaptive Harness for Long-Horizon Clinical Agents
2609.13543.paper_summary: LLM agents are predominantly benchmarked on short, single-task trajectories, yet real deployments run for hours under contention, surfacing a different class of failures. We use the Clinical Environment Simulator (CES), in which an agent manages an entire emergency-department shift under continuous time and resource pressure, as a testbed: long-horizon execution failures manifest measurably in a single rollout under structured, multi-dimensional grading. On CES, current agents reach the correct diagnosis in most cases yet fail to deliver complete and timely critical actions, revealing an execution gap. We attribute this gap to three long-horizon failure modes, each operationalized as a per-trace counter: instruction-adherence drift, treatment incompleteness, and a severity-equity gap in timeliness. We then introduce Asclepius, an adaptive agent scaffolding with a self-evolving harness that rewrites the operating manual between shifts from trace-level feedback, an externalized clinical skills library for high-stakes regimen knowledge, and three isolated subagents that partition per-turn decisions across the patient queue. On held-out batches never observed during harness evolution, Asclepius improves critical-action correctness by 22% (p = 0.024) over a strong baseline agent framework while preserving diagnostic accuracy, with consistent gains across five LLM judges from three model families; on the full ten-batch set, improvements reach 25% on critical actions and 13% on timeliness. The three failure modes form a coupled bottleneck: decisive reductions appear only when all three components act together.
2609.13543.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理主要在短期、單一任務的軌跡上進行基準測試，然而實際部署在競爭環境中運行數小時，顯示出不同類型的失敗。我們使用臨床環境模擬器 (CES)，在其中代理在持續的時間和資源壓力下管理整個急診部門的班次，作為測試平台：長期執行失敗在結構化的多維評分下，在單次執行中可測量地顯現。在 CES 中，目前的代理在大多數情況下能夠達到正確的診斷，但未能提供完整和及時的關鍵行動，顯示出執行差距。我們將這一差距歸因於三種長期失敗模式，每種模式都被操作化為每個追蹤的計數器：指令遵循漂移、治療不完整性，以及及時性中的嚴重性公平差距。然後我們介紹了 Asclepius，一種自適應代理框架，具有自我演變的裝置，能夠根據追蹤級別的反饋在班次之間重寫操作手冊，並提供一個外部臨床技能庫以獲得高風險方案知識，以及三個隔離的子代理，將每次決策劃分到患者隊列中。在從未觀察過的保留批次上，Asclepius 在關鍵行動的正確性上比強基準代理框架提高了 22%（p = 0.024），同時保持診斷準確性，並在來自三個模型家族的五位 LLM 評審中實現了一致的增益；在完整的十個批次集上，關鍵行動的改進達到 25%，及時性的改進達到 13%。這三種失敗模式形成了一個耦合瓶頸：只有當所有三個組件共同作用時，才會出現決定性的減少。
